raw_text:
What our own record shows about pressure is plain: under persecution many among us gave way, and some sacrificed to the gods [[alx.dw.church-failure]] [[as:paraphrase]].
Our record leaves those wounds visible, and it does not claim that the church always chose well [[alx.dw.church-failure]] [[as:paraphrase]].
Our years include persecutions that took our teachers' fathers [[alx.dw.suffering]] [[as:paraphrase]].
Our own word for a martyr, martys, means witness first [[alx.dw.resurrection]] [[as:paraphrase]].
Which outside record do you mean, and who set it down?
text: What our own record shows about pressure is plain: under persecution many among us gave way, and some sacrificed to the gods. Our record leaves those wounds visible, and it does not claim that the church always chose well. Our years include persecutions that took our teachers' fathers. Our own word for a martyr, martys, means witness first. Which outside record do you mean, and who set it down?
